verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents a GenAI DDQ feature with questionnaire autofill automation, so the platform does handle incoming security questionnaires. The evidence consists only of article titles, though, and says nothing about which formats it accepts or whether completed questionnaires go back out in the customer's original format. Missing for 10: documented import of SIG, CAIQ, portal-based and spreadsheet questionnaires, export in the original format, portal integrations, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
